privacy-policy.title: How Flurzi handles personal information.
privacy-policy.intro: This privacy policy explains how Flurzi Mobile App Limited may collect, use, protect and retain personal information across this website and the Flurzi product family. Last updated: 23 May 2026.

sections.title: Who this applies to
paragraphs: This policy applies to visitors, product users, prospective customers, employers, workers, readers, viewers, support contacts and anyone who communicates with Flurzi through this website or one of our platforms.

sections.title: Information we may collect
paragraphs: We may collect contact details, account details, organisation details, support messages, enquiry content, billing or subscription records where applicable, device and security logs, and product usage information. SponsorSafe HR may involve employer compliance records and worker-related documents. Flurzi Commit may involve commitment settings, progress records and payment-related workflow data. FlurziCinema and End Novel may involve viewing, reading, saved library, preference or content activity data.

sections.title: How we use information
paragraphs: We use information to provide and improve our products, respond to enquiries, manage accounts, support product access, maintain security, process payments where applicable, send service messages, keep operational records and comply with legal obligations.

sections.title: Lawful basis
paragraphs: Depending on the context, we may process personal information because it is necessary for a contract, because we have a legitimate interest in operating and improving our services, because we must comply with a legal obligation, because you gave consent, or because we need to take steps before entering into a contract.

sections.title: Sharing information
paragraphs: We may share information with trusted service providers who support hosting, payment processing, communications, security, support and product operations. We do not sell personal information. Where a provider processes information for us, we expect it to act only on agreed instructions and protect the data appropriately.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal information only for as long as reasonably needed for the purpose it was collected, including account support, product records, security, legal, tax, audit and dispute-resolution requirements. Retention periods may differ between products because the data and obligations are different.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under UK data protection law, individuals may have rights to access, correct, erase, restrict, object to processing, request portability and complain to the Information Commissioner's Office. Privacy requests can be sent to hello@flurzimobileapp.co.uk.

terms.title: The terms for using Flurzi websites and products.
terms.intro: These terms set the baseline rules for using Flurzi websites, communications and digital products. Product-specific agreements, subscription terms or enterprise contracts may add further conditions. Last updated: 23 May 2026.

sections.title: Using our services
paragraphs: You must use Flurzi services lawfully, provide accurate information where required, keep account credentials secure and remain responsible for activity under your account.

sections.title: Product scope
paragraphs: SponsorSafe HR provides software workflows for employer compliance operations. Flurzi Commit provides structured commitment and progress-tracking features. FlurziCinema provides entertainment discovery and viewing features. End Novel provides story discovery and reading features. None of the products replaces professional legal, immigration, financial, tax or debt advice.

sections.title: Accounts and access
paragraphs: Some products may require account registration, verification, permissions or role-based access. We may suspend or restrict access where we reasonably believe an account is being misused, creates security risk or breaches these terms.

sections.title: Payments and subscriptions
paragraphs: Where a product includes paid access, trial periods, subscription fees or enterprise agreements, the relevant price, billing cycle, renewal rules and cancellation terms should be shown before purchase or set out in a separate agreement.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: You must not attempt unauthorised access, interfere with product security, upload unlawful or harmful content, scrape restricted areas, reverse engineer protected systems, impersonate others or use Flurzi products to harm people, organisations or services.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Flurzi owns or licenses the design, software, content, branding and product materials used across its websites and platforms. You may not copy, reuse or distribute those materials except as permitted by law or agreed in writing.

sections.title: Service changes
paragraphs: We may improve, update, suspend or discontinue features where needed for security, operations, legal compliance or product development. We will aim to communicate material service changes where appropriate.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: Flurzi aims to provide reliable products, but users remain responsible for decisions, records, uploads, compliance actions, payments, content choices and use of information. Liability may be limited to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law.

disclaimer.title: Important limits on product information and advice.
disclaimer.intro: Flurzi products are designed to support clearer workflows and digital experiences. They do not replace professional advice, independent verification or user responsibility. Last updated: 23 May 2026.

sections.title: No legal or immigration advice
paragraphs: SponsorSafe HR may help organise sponsor licence records, right to work evidence, reminders and audit preparation workflows. It does not provide legal, immigration or Home Office advice. Employers should consult qualified advisers where needed.

sections.title: No financial advice
paragraphs: Flurzi Commit may support commitment planning, progress tracking and behavioural structure. It does not provide regulated financial, investment, tax, debt, savings or credit advice.

sections.title: Entertainment and reading content
paragraphs: FlurziCinema and End Novel may surface entertainment, stories, rankings, recommendations or viewing and reading experiences. Content availability, categorisation and presentation may change over time.

sections.title: Information accuracy
paragraphs: We aim to keep product information useful and accurate, but laws, guidance, fees, product features, third-party requirements and content availability may change. Users should verify high-stakes information before acting.

sections.title: User responsibility
paragraphs: Users remain responsible for their own compliance decisions, financial decisions, account activity, records, uploads, viewing choices, reading choices and actions taken inside or outside Flurzi products.

data-protection.title: How Flurzi approaches data protection and security.
data-protection.intro: Flurzi designs its products around trust, appropriate access controls and careful handling of personal, operational and product data. Last updated: 23 May 2026.

sections.title: Governance
paragraphs: We aim to handle data in line with UK GDPR principles, including lawfulness, fairness, transparency, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity and confidentiality.

sections.title: Access controls
paragraphs: Product access should be limited by role, account permissions and authentication so sensitive records are visible only to appropriate users.

sections.title: Secure transmission
paragraphs: Flurzi websites and products should use HTTPS/TLS for data in transit. Sensitive data should be protected with suitable technical and organisational measures according to the product and risk level.

sections.title: Auditability
paragraphs: SponsorSafe HR is intended to support timestamped, attributable and exportable compliance records where audit trails matter. Other products may maintain operational logs for account, security and support purposes.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Data should be kept only for appropriate product, business, legal, security or audit purposes, then deleted or anonymised according to retention settings and applicable law.

sections.title: Incident response
paragraphs: If a personal data incident occurs, Flurzi should assess the risk, take steps to contain and reduce harm, document the incident and notify affected parties or regulators where legally required.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Data protection enquiries can be sent to hello@flurzimobileapp.co.uk.
